facts.text: "Samuel, no gadgets at the table. Eat your dinner and then we read something nice, not that book."
facts.why: Amelia never says this. It is in quote marks and signed Amelia, so it reads as a film line. A real Amelia line is her shout at the monster in the house.
facts.fix: This is my house! You are trespassing in my house!
